# His & Her Hair Styles

> Family hair salon based in Bloomington, Indiana. Haircuts, beard lines, perms, color and waxing on South Rogers Street in Bloomington. Friendly stylists who listen to what you want, make you feel at home, and show you how to look after it.

- Phone: (812) 336-1105

- Nearby areas: Bloomington, Ellettsville, Bedford, Spencer, Martinsville, Nashville
- Google rating: 4.8 from 68 reviews

## Services
- Cuts for him, her & kids: Everyday cuts for men, women and kids, done the way you ask, by stylists who'll tell you honestly what suits you.
- Perms, color & foils: Perms (beach waves too), color, foils and balayage, with tips on caring for it at home.
- Waxing: Friendly, unhurried waxing that IU students recommend to their friends.

## About
His & Her Hair Styles is a family salon at 2312 S Rogers St in Bloomington, cutting hair for men, women and kids. Locals, families and IU students all end up in the same striped-wall room, and Nextdoor neighbors voted it a Neighborhood Favorite in 2020, 2021 and 2023. Customers come back for the people. Reviews name stylists like Twila, Josh, Carrie and Chloe, and longtime favorites like Nancy and Anila, and they say the same things: they listen, they take their time, and they make you feel comfortable. One regular has had the same stylist for almost ten years. Beyond cuts and beard lines, the salon does perms (yes, beach waves), color, foils and balayage, and waxing. Grab a coffee at the teal buffet while you wait.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. Closed Saturday and Sunday. Call (812) 336-1105 to book a time.
- Q: Do you cut men's, women's and kids' hair?
  A: Yes. It's in the name: cuts for him and her, and the kids too, including men's cuts with a clean beard line.
- Q: Do you still do perms?
  A: Yes. Perms are a regular here, including softer beach-wave perms. Color, foils and balayage too.
- Q: Do you do waxing?
  A: Yes. Waxing is popular with IU students. Ask for Chloe when you call.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 2312 S Rogers St, Bloomington, IN 47403, on the south side of town, a short drive from the IU campus.
- Q: Can I ask for a specific stylist?
  A: Of course. Plenty of regulars ask for their stylist by name. Mention who you want when you call.
